Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our application focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations Our objective is to organise anyone's life. Â Role As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets. You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work. Â What You'll Own Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets. Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets. Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications. Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows. Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices. Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly. Â What We're Looking For Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies. Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance. Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces. Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces. Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details. Able to independently own features from technical design through production. Â Outcomes Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets. Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable. AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences. Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows. Â Tech Stack TypeScript React.js / Next.js HTML / CSS WebSockets / streaming APIs Node.js REST / GraphQL APIs Â How We Work The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.description: CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role. The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy. About the Role Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including: Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands Skincare and beauty Tech and software Finance and investing Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability Education Home improvement Automobiles and motorcycles Health and wellness Medical and clinical fields Digital marketing SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply. Responsibilities Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team Qualifications Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content Portfolio featuring published work preferred Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred Compensation Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric. Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate Application Process Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Vehicle Configuration Platform
jobs.description: About Us Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world. The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone. Role Summary A single firmware release must serve every vehicle variant we build across both Rivian and all Volkswagen brands. The vehicle configuration platform that the OTA team supports makes that possible: a schema-driven system that defines every configurable attribute of a vehicle and provisions them onto vehicles in the factory, in service, and over the air customer updates. Getting this wrong can mean anything from the wrong information showing on the driver display to a car that needs to be towed in for service. You will be a technical leader on the team that owns this platform, working as a peer to its lead architect. Where the architect drives the structural evolution of the configuration system itself, you will own the health, reliability, and scalability of everything around it: the compilation and code generation pipelines, the validation and release infrastructure, the provisioning path from schema to vehicle, and the developer experience of every engineer who touches configuration. You will set technical direction for this surface area, drive initiatives that span firmware, build infrastructure, release engineering, OTA, and factory integration across two companies' engineering organizations, and raise the bar for how the team designs, reviews, and ships. This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite, with occasional travel to other company and partner sites as needed. Responsibilities Own the technical direction for configuration tooling, validation, and delivery infrastructure, translating platform architecture into a concrete, sequenced roadmap and driving it to completion across teams. Lead initiatives that simplify the platform: consolidating redundant mechanisms, retiring legacy pathways, and reducing the coordination cost of routine changes, while every downstream consumer keeps working. Design the compatibility strategy for data contracts deployed to devices in the field, and build the automated enforcement that makes schema evolution provably safe rather than carefully reviewed. Architect the validation and release pipeline as a product: define what classes of defects must be impossible to merge, and build the layered checks, staged rollouts, and observability that get there. Serve as the senior escalation point for production configuration issues, leading root cause analysis during launches and field events and converting each incident into systemic prevention. Drive alignment across organizational boundaries, negotiating shared contracts, review processes, and release mechanics with firmware, cloud, diagnostics, manufacturing, and partner-brand stakeholders who have differing constraints and conventions. Mentor and multiply the engineers on the team, setting standards through design review, raising the quality of technical writing and decision records, and growing the mid-level engineers toward ownership. Be accountable for the long-term maintenance cost of what the team ships. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications: 8+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated ownership of a platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing system used by many teams. A track record of leading cross-team technical initiatives from proposal through delivery, including ones that required deprecating or migrating away from entrenched systems

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer  | Robotics
jobs.description: We build humanoid systems: full stack, from hardware and electronics to software and manufacturing, all in-house in Berlin. At Cell Labs, we push the boundary of what robotics can achieve. Our goal is clear: to build systems that empower humans, not replace them. Our technology is already deployed with industry leading customers and partners. Now, our own product is close to launch. The quiet phase is over. We are looking for people who want to be here early, take ownership, and help us build what others only talk about. Location: Berlin (on-site) Start: Asap Employment Type: Full-time Tasks Mechanical Design & CAD: Design and develop mechanical components and assemblies for humanoid systems, from actuators and kinematic mechanisms to sensor mounts and protective enclosures and model them in CAD (e.g. Onshape). Actuator Kinematics: Design and optimize the kinematic structure of the robot's joints and limbs, including joint layouts, degrees of freedom, ranges of motion, and transmission mechanisms. Select and integrate actuators (motors, gearboxes, encoders) so that torque, speed, and load requirements are met across the full motion range. Production Readiness: Optimize designs for series production with product requirements, user experience, and target cost in mind. Prepare the handover to manufacturing, including assembly processes, jigs and fixtures, and supplier ramp-up. Prototyping & Testing: Prototype and validate mechanical systems for performance, safety, and durability. Design and build test rigs for actuators and subassemblies, including endurance and load testing. Electronics Integration & Wiring: Integrate PCBs, sensors, and batteries into mechanical assemblies, including cable routing and heat management. Build and solder cables and wiring harnesses for prototypes and test setups. Analysis & Materials: Run stress analysis and weight optimization to improve performance and longevity. Research, test, and qualify new materials and processes, such as composites and additive manufacturing. Documentation & Specifications: Maintain complete design documentation, including drawings, part specifications, BOMs, and wiring diagrams, with full traceability throughout development. Requirements Background: You studied mechanical engineering, mechatronics, robotics, electrical engineering, or something close to it. Experience: At least 3 years working on robotic systems, mobile machinery, or similar electromechanical products. What you built matters more to us than where you built it. Mechanical Design: You've designed complex mechanical systems and understand robot kinematics, actuators, and how mechanical and electrical parts come together in a working robot. Manufacturing: You know CNC machining, injection molding, sheet metal, and additive manufacturing, and you design with mid- and high-volume production in mind. You've worked with suppliers and brought hardware into production. Hands-on: You like building things yourself. You solder cables, put together wiring harnesses, build test rigs, and track down problems on the bench. Tools: You work confidently in Onshape and Autodesk Fusion, including its electronics design tools. Product lifecycle: Ideally, you've taken at least one hardware product all the way from concept to series production. How you work: You get a first prototype built quickly and improve from there. You can keep several projects moving at once and know when a design is good enough to move forward. Languages: Fluent English. German is a plus. Benefits Your work goes into a real robot: The joints, assemblies, and test rigs you design end up in humanoid robots we build ourselves. You take ownership of real subsystems and see them go from CAD to working hardware. Everything under one roof: Office, workshop, and test rigs are in the same building in Kreuzberg. Your design goes from screen to prototype in days. The electrical and software engineers are a short walk away, not a ticket**.**

jobs.title: Senior SAP HCM Solution & Integration Architect - Freelance
jobs.description: For an international enterprise environment, we are looking for an experienced Senior HR IT / SAP HCM Solution & Integration Architect to support a global HR technology transformation and transition program. The role combines HR application architecture, integration architecture, technical governance and hands-on SAP HCM expertise . This is not a classic Payroll role and not a purely functional SAP HCM consulting position. Start: Mid-November 2026 Duration: 6 months+ Go-live: Planned for January / February 2027 Contract: Freelance Workload: 100% Location: Remote Language: English We are specifically looking for a technically strong SAP HCM Solution / Integration Architect . Profiles focused primarily on SAP Payroll, SuccessFactors Payroll or purely functional SAP HCM consulting without architecture and integration responsibility are not suitable for this assignment. Tasks Design and further develop the global HR application and integration architecture Act as technical lead and design authority for the implementation team Design and review integrations between SAP HCM, S/4HANA, SuccessFactors and other enterprise systems Work with SAP Integration Suite / CPI, APIs, OData, REST, SOAP and middleware technologies Define architecture principles, technical standards, data flows and integration governance Support security architecture, IAM, RBAC, segregation of duties and GDPR requirements Support audit findings, test cycles, technical issue resolution and go-live preparation Take over from the current consultant and support go-live, stabilization and ongoing technical ownership Requirements Extensive experience in HR IT, SAP HCM, Solution Architecture or Enterprise Architecture Strong SAP HCM background, ideally including Core HR, Personnel Administration and Organizational Management Strong experience in Solution Architecture and Integration Architecture Experience with SAP S/4HANA and/or SAP SuccessFactors Strong integration experience with SAP Integration Suite / CPI, APIs and middleware Strong technical understanding beyond purely functional SAP HCM consulting Experience with global / multi-country landscapes, security, IAM, roles and GDPR Fluent English, strong stakeholder communication and experience leading technical teams Nice-to-haves Business Object Repository SAP Shared Memory Carve-out or transition experience Global SAP transformation programs Application Operations Post-go-live stabilization / hypercare Experience in international corporate environments Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

When a structural engineer changes a component in their building design model, the same component exists in drawings, schedules, specs and emails under different names, in different formats, some of which LLMs don’t understand, and with no shared identifier. Detecting these changes, predicting the downstream impacts and propagating them using AI under the engineer's supervision is the core of our product. You'll own the UX/UI for the whole product, not a slice of it. There's no design team to inherit and no feature factory to work around. You set the direction, the patterns and the quality bar, and you'll prototype, test and ship rapidly with a small team that can pivot, fast. Your work ships to people who pay. With our tight feedback loops, you’ll have plenty of data to help drive your design decisions. What we're building Structural engineers work across numerous, fragmented sets of tools with no shared source of truth. When a design changes, propagating that change across files is manual, slow and error-prone, and the errors are expensive. Bite is the change management and audit trail layer for structural engineering. The platform does three things that today take weeks of manual work: natural-language search across a project's entire file ecosystem, cross-file impact detection e.g. "I changed Column C7 in the structural model - what drawings, schedules, and specs are now out of date?" and propagation of those changes to every affected file. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.   Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. You will lead the end-to-end design and delivery of complex data pipelines and cloud infrastructure, ingesting, processing, and serving large-scale data to our global customers . Acting as a technical leader, you will set data architecture directions and mentor peer engineers, ensuring our platform reliably scales as our datasets and product offerings expand . Ensure data integrity and event streaming: Architect robust PostgreSQL database structures and event-streaming flows (Kafka/Flink) to guarantee seamless data flow and integrity . Set technical direction and standards: Lead complex pipeline design, peer reviews, and logging, monitoring, and alerting frameworks to maintain pipeline resilience . Partner cross-functionally and mentor peers: Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and data scientists while mentoring engineers to elevate team craft and technical development . Evaluate emerging data tools: Research and implement modern data infrastructure improvements and frameworks to continuously elevate Kpler's platform capabilities . Experience & Background What you'll need (Must-haves) Data engineering experience at scale: 5+ years of experience designing, operating, and owning production-grade data pipelines and infrastructure . Core tech stack depth: Strong Python skills with hands-on experience in Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Airflow, and relational databases like PostgreSQL . Streaming, IaC, and observability: Practical experience with event streaming (Kafka/Flink), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), CI/CD practices, and production logging/monitoring systems . Technical leadership & AI coding tools: Demonstrated ability to lead architectural discussions, mentor engineers, and leverage AI-assisted coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude) with strong technical judgment . Methodologies & communication: Experience working in Agile environments with strong collaboration skills and fluency in written and spoken English . Nice-to-haves Large-scale analytics platforms: Experience building large-scale data processing systems or analytics platforms . Cross-team initiatives: Track record of leading technical initiatives across multiple teams . Domain knowledge: Familiarity with commodities, shipping, energy, or marine insurance market data . By bringing clarity to ambiguity, connecting work across Product and Platform Engineering and making sure teams have the information they need, the role helps reduce rework, improve delivery and build better software for our customers. Key Responsibilities Discovery and shaping Work with stakeholders to explore ideas, requests and feedback, clarifying the underlying problem, business need and intended outcome before work is defined Explore the reasons behind requests before work is defined, ensuring relevant context and requirements are understood. Challenge assumptions constructively, identify gaps and surface conflicting needs or unanswered questions early. Identify and engage the right stakeholders to provide the information and decisions needed to shape clear requirements. Turning needs into actionable work Translate business needs into clear epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria that give engineering teams sufficient context to progress work effectively. Break down defined or moderately complex initiatives into clear, deliverable increments, working with Product and Engineering colleagues and seeking support on more complex work where needed, Maintain accurate requirements and supporting context in Jira, including agreed scope, relevant decisions and material changes. Keep requirements current as understanding or scope develops, working with relevant Product, Engineering and project colleagues to capture what has changed and why. Question resolution during delivery Remain closely involved during delivery as a point of contact for requirements-related questions and clarification. Investigate ambiguity, work with the right stakeholders to resolve requirements questions and escalate more complex issues where needed so engineering teams can continue with clear direction. Participate in refinement and planning discussions where business analysis input is needed to clarify scope, requirements or agreed decisions. Maintain traceability from the original business need through agreed requirements and material changes to what is ultimately delivered. Integrating product and platform work Maintain awareness of relevant work across Product and Platform Engineering and identify dependencies, overlaps or potential impacts between teams. Help shape requirements where product and platform changes need to work together, ensuring relevant dependencies and constraints are understood. Flag where teams may be addressing the same problem, where proposed changes could conflict, or where work in one area creates an impact elsewhere. Support effective handovers and cross-team working by ensuring teams have the requirements context and documentation they need. Stakeholder engagement Build constructive working relationships across Product, Engineering, QA, customer-facing teams and the wider business. Translate engineering questions and constraints into clear language for business stakeholders. Translate business needs and agreed intent into precise, actionable requirements for engineering teams. Help stakeholders understand what has been agreed from a requirements perspective, what remains unresolved and where further input or decisions are needed. Essential experience Proven experience as a Business Analyst, or in a closely related analysis role, within software delivery. jobs.description: Powering Great Work We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists: 🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business 🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time 🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country As our next Senior Software Engineer in Trust & Safety, you'll own the systems that decide how tradespeople are checked, how reviews are processed and how our marketplace stays honest at scale. You'll work alongside the vetting and reviews teams, who are on the front line of trust, and build the infrastructure that lets them work with confidence. When something breaks in production, you'll lead the response. When something looks brittle at design time, you'll say so. The job, unfiltered: Own and evolve the systems behind how tradespeople are verified, how reviews flow through our platform and how content is moderated. Lead the response when things break: read distributed traces, correlate logs across services and find the cause, not just the symptom. Design event-driven workflows that are reliable by default: idempotent, retryable, with dead-letter handling that doesn't need a 2am wake-up to unpick. Work directly with the vetting and reviews teams to understand what trust means day to day, then build systems that hold up to it. Tighten the operational seams: better monitoring, clearer alerting, locked-down auth and outbox patterns that keep data consistent. The fit: Strong TypeScript. You're comfortable owning a service end to end, from schema to deployment. Fastify or a similar Node.js framework, and enough HTTP know-how that it rarely surprises you. Event-driven instincts: you know what idempotency means in practice and why the outbox pattern exists. Full-stack comfort, Next.js included. You ship the frontend as happily as the service behind it. Datadog fluency (APM traces, log search, metric queries), SQL for diagnostics during an incident, and GCP basics such as Pub/Sub backlogs and DLQs. Experience leading production incidents, not just being in them. You communicate clearly under pressure and drive to a fix. An eye for systemic problems at review time, not at post-mortem time, and a habit of making the people around you better. Regular use of AI tools like Cursor or Claude Code, and a keen interest in helping the team get more out of them. You don't need to know our Trust & Safety domain yet (the review lifecycle, vetting disposition logic, publish timing). You'll pick it up. What matters is that you learn fast and take it seriously. (Don't self-select out because you don't tick every box. We'd rather meet you.) What you get 💰 Competitive salary, annual bonus & equity scheme 🩺 Health, wellbeing and learning support 🚲 Gym membership, Smart Tech Scheme, Cycle Scheme 🎂 Birthday/special day leave, buy & sell holiday scheme ❤️ 1 week's paid charity leave, and more How this goes Screening call with one of our Talent Acquisition Partners Technical interview with members of the team Final stage with the hiring manager and a senior stakeholder Not this one? With more than 50,000 trades listed and over 6 million reviews, we help homeowners get jobs done right and help tradespeople grow their business. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we’re simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel. About the role: What you’ll be doing: Manage a team of recruiters setting workload priorities, running 1:1s, keeping a pulse on pipelines, and supporting their development Partner closely with leaders on recruitment strategy and delivery across all functions, with a particular focus on scaling technical hiring Maintain and improve a structured interview infrastructure so the whole team runs a consistent, high-signal process Use data and insight to ensure a strong recruitment infrastructure, tracking and reporting on hiring KPIs through, quality-control on pipelines, and leaning on Ashby workflows Be the escalation point for hiring managers when a process isn't working Own end to end hiring, personally running search and building pipelines on technical, senior or niche roles alongside the team What we're looking for: Extensive recruiting experience at a tech first company, including owning hiring metrics and reporting to senior leaders, not just running requisitions. Experience leading, coaching and developing experienced recruiters, including planning team capacity against a hiring plan and rebalancing workload, rather than managing day to day. A quality-over-quantity mindset, with experience defining and tracking Quality of Hire and using it to steer where you source candidates and how the team hires. jobs.description: This is an Atlantic portfolio company. Why we exist Every frontier model is now gated by two things: megawatts and cooling . Grid queues stretch for years, land is contested, freshwater is political. Far offshore, the wind blows stronger and steadier than anywhere on Earth, a vast resource the grid can, by definition, never reach. So we flipped the problem. Instead of bringing power to the load, we bring the load to the power. Our autonomous wind-turbine energy ships chase the wind across the open ocean and convert it on board into what the world needs most: compute first, then e-fuels to decarbonise aviation. 70%+ capacity factor — offshore wind that behaves like baseload ~€50/MWh target cost for firm, low-carbon power Zero grid queue. Zero freshwater. Zero land. And the ocean as the heat sink under every rack. Founded in 2025 by repeat entrepreneurs (with successful exits) and industrial operators. Backed by major international investors. First demonstrator vessel at sea in late 2027. The role This is not a sales job. It's a late co-founder seat. You will own Offshore Compute , our first and main commercial engine: strategy, product, pricing, customers and the multi-million-dollar off-take deals that put our first fleet to work. You already know that power and thermal limits are what will stall AI scaling. You're bold enough to believe infrastructure at sea can get around both, and rigorous enough to prove it to a sceptical buyer. What you'll do Write the go-to-market from a blank page. Build the global commercial roadmap, from first demonstrator workloads to full fleet monetisation. Land the anchor deals. Negotiate and close off-take agreements, capacity reservations and JVs with neoclouds, AI labs, CSPs and Tier-1 HPC operators. Turn variable power into a feature. Design offers built for wind-backed power profiles: fault-tolerant batch training, asynchronous inference, dynamic pricing, zero-carbon AI clouds. Connect the C-suite to the hull. Translate client requirements (SLA, latency, direct-to-chip liquid cooling) into onboard architecture specs together with our marine engineers. Create a category. Use our advantages — no grid wait, no freshwater, a direct ocean cooling sink, very low carbon intensity — to win premium pricing and long-term commitments, and establish floating compute as a new asset class. Be the face of it. Represent us at the top AI, cloud and infrastructure summits worldwide and make us the reference for next-generation AI energy infrastructure. You might be the one if You've been in the room where AI capacity gets bought. We care about what you've shipped, not what your business card said. You know GPU economics inside out. H100 / B200 / GB200 cluster economics, orchestration, workload constraints. And you know the people across the neocloud and AI ecosystem who sign capacity deals. You speak the physics. MW-scale power delivery, PUE, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, thermal budgets. You can explain in one slide why land-based data centers are hitting the grid wall. You've built something from zero. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Search (remote, Europe)
jobs.description: Hey, I'm Adrian . I’m hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Data Search team at Modash. Modash helps brands find, understand, and work with creators across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. More than 2,700 companies—including Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN—use us to manage and scale their creator partnerships. Behind that product is a fascinating search problem: helping customers find the right people across 400M+ creator profiles and billions of media files. We’re combining large-scale data processing, traditional retrieval, vector search, multimodal embeddings, and LLMs to make that possible. That’s where you come in. Why we're hiring Search at Modash isn't an internal platform or a support function. It is one of the core products customers use to discover creators. The scale is large, the data is messy, and the search intent is often complex. A customer might be looking for creators in a specific niche, people whose content conveys a certain visual style, or accounts that resemble a group they already know. Solving that well requires more than adding another filter or calling an LLM API. We need a senior engineer who can work across the full retrieval system—from data and indexing pipelines to embeddings, ranking, relevance, and low-latency serving—and take ambiguous product problems all the way to production. You’ll join the specialised Data Search team and work closely with Data Core, Data Insights, product teams, customers, and company leadership. You’ll have real autonomy, but you won’t work in isolation. If you want a feel for how we think about building software, check our Engineering Blog . What you'll actually own 1. Make creator search meaningfully better. You’ll improve how customers discover creators across 400M+ profiles and billions of media files. That includes retrieval, filtering, ranking, relevance, speed, and the product decisions that connect them. 2. Turn multimodal data into searchable intelligence. You’ll build systems that generate and use embeddings from images, video, text, and audio at massive scale—then make those signals useful in a real customer-facing search experience. 3. Ship new search capabilities into production. You’ll evaluate models and technologies pragmatically, understand tradeoffs around cost, latency, and quality, and move promising approaches from experiment to a reliable production system within weeks rather than quarters. 4. Own the system end to end. You’ll help shape the problem, gather requirements, design the architecture, write the code, release it, measure the outcome, and improve it. Senior engineers here own results, not just implementation tasks. What the day-to-day looks like Here’s what a typical week might include: Monday. A customer search is returning technically relevant but unhelpful results. You inspect the retrieval and ranking stages, identify where intent is being lost, and propose a measurable improvement. Tuesday. Deep-focus time. You build a pipeline to generate multimodal embeddings across a large batch of creator content and test how the new representation affects retrieval quality and cost. Wednesday. You work with Data Insights on a new in-house datapoint. Together, you agree on its definition, coverage, and data-quality requirements, then expose it in Search to give customers more ways to discover creators. Thursday. You test a reranking model on a fixed set of real customer queries. You measure how much it improves relevance against the latency and inference cost it adds, then decide what's ready for production. Friday. You review production metrics, investigate a relevance regression, and share what you learned with the team. The fix may be in the model, the data, the query logic, or the product itself—you follow the evidence. We keep meetings purposeful and protect time for deep work. You’ll have a short standup, close collaboration when it helps, and plenty of space to design, build, optimise, and launch. Requirements What you've done

telecom workflows and integrations</li> <li>Act as a QA representative in customer engagements, including demos, UAT phases, and escalations</li> <li>Partner with customers to define acceptance criteria, success metrics, and quality benchmarks</li> <li>Lead QA support for customer onboarding, migrations, and go-live activities</li> <li>Partner with Sales and Pre-Sales to Define delivery and QA strategies for proposals and RFPs</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>12+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, with 5+ years in leadership roles</li> <li>Strong supporting sales/pre-sales activities (RFPs, demos, client discussions)</li> <li>Deep understanding of QA methodologies, automation frameworks, and DevOps practices</li> <li>Experience managing jobs.description: As Mechanical Engineer, within Distalmotion’s Instruments – Product Improvement team, you will be responsible for driving product optimization initiatives with a strong emphasis on cost reduction, manufacturing efficiency, and continuous product improvement for the Instruments of the surgical system. The Mechanical Engineer brings solid experience in component and tooling design with associated impact analysis (impact on design verification, risk assessment, quality and manufacturing costs) and root cause investigation of clinical complaints and/or non-conformities. Tasks : Design & Cost Optimization • Specify design, prototype, and implement mechanical components and custom tooling/fixtures with a strong focus on Design for Manufacturing, Assembly and Cost (DFM/DFA/DFC). • Identify, justify and execute cost reduction opportunities on existing instruments without compromising performance, quality or safety. • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders from manufacturing of prototypes to testing and industrialization of the products. Impact analysis • Perform comprehensive impact analysis of the proposed design changes, evaluating effects on manufacturing processes, unit costs, risk management and design verification. • Evaluate financial impact of proposed design changes, including tooling/fixture investments, scrap reduction and cycle time improvement. • Define technical requirements and test protocols and ensure traceability with the design in test reports. Supervise and participate to design verification. • Collaborate with internal teams (Ops, QA, RA). • The compliance with the applicable laws and standards and the design control practices is a must (e.g. ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR 820, MDR). Continuous Improvement • Investigate clinical complaints and production non-conformity. • Lead root cause analysis and manage Corrective and Preventive Actions to drive continuous product quality and reliability improvements. Requirements Education & Experience • Mechanical, microtechnology engineering degree or equivalent (BSc or MSc) • At least 5 years of experience in the medical device industry or highly regulated environment (eg. Aerospace, automotive) Technical competency • Proficiency in CAD (SOLIDWORKS preferred) • Design For Manufacturing experience (plastic and metal injection, stamping, …), for medium to high volume manufacturing • Relevant experience in Design Control (Design input/output/transfer, Risk Analysis, Failure mode analysis) • Knowledge of change management workflows Soft Skills • Strong analytical, problem-solving, pragmatic and creative skills • Good communication skills with proactive attitude and strong accountability under limited supervision • Language: French, English Benefits What we offer : A dynamic, innovative environment with cutting-edge medical technology that is shaping the future of robotic surgery. Fast-growing Company where innovation meets agility. Structured onboarding program and training, ensuring a confident start. High degree of autonomy and flexibility. jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
jobs.description: Description Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes. You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind. Your mission 1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution. Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy. Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters. Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo. 2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer. Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders). Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice. Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos. 3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation. Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations. Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder. What We Want to Achieve Together In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds. In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount. Your profile Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies. Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences. Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility. Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data. AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new. A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough. Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both. Why us? R

Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation.  About the Job The autonomy team at Gravis architects autonomous behaviors for different tasks, e.g. different types of excavation or truck loading. This role owns the architecture that lets those behaviors live in the same software stack as opposed to creating one SW stack per behavior. You'll be responsible for how tasks are decomposed and orchestrated, for the interfaces between, and for the software quality. We are looking for a senior roboticist with C++ and Python expertise and high standards for software quality, who can make clear, pragmatic architectural calls that let the system grow without losing stability. jobs.title: Senior Embedded Linux Engineer
jobs.description: Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.  Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.  Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.  The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation.  About the role At Gravis, we build high tech systems that give machine operators super human capabilities. To adapt in real time to changes in the environment the Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into an autonomous control system. All of it runs on Linux, on compute hardware we design ourselves, bolted to the roof of a machine that vibrates, overheats, and regularly loses network coverage. As a senior engineer focused on the embedded platform, you will own the software layer closest to that hardware: bootloader, kernel, device tree, root filesystem, and the update mechanism that keeps the fleet current. You will work at the intersection of our Hardware, Firmware, Autonomy, and Perception teams to bring up new boards alongside the engineers who designed them, then hand the software organization a platform they can build on without thinking about it. When something fails on site and nobody can yet say whether it's a driver or a solder joint, you are the person who finds out. What you’ll do Own the embedded Linux platform from end to end: bootloader, kernel, device tree and rootfs. Bring up new hardware alongside electrical engineers.  Take our boards from first power-up to a boot you’d trust on a customer site. Write and maintain the kernel drivers that connect the Rack’s sensors to the autonomy stack Be the low level link between hardware and software teams; the person who can tell a driver bug from a hardware fault. Drive our OTA update and recovery strategy for machines around the world Implement security hardening: secure boot, disk encryption, container isolation, vulnerability patching. What we're looking for We recognize that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with varied combinations of skills. If you meet most of the core qualifications below, we encourage you to apply. Degree in Electrical/Computer Engineering, CS, or related field. Deep knowledge of Linux kernel internals: device drivers, device tree, interrupt handling, memory management, scheduling. Experience with custom hardware bring-up: pin muxing, clock configuration, regulator control, PCIe, USB, I2C, SPI, UART, CSI, Ethernet. Strong understanding of circuit diagrams and digital electronics. Self-driven, able to take full ownership in a fast-moving startup. Good English (written and spoken) is a must. Bonus Qualifications Yocto, Buildroot, nixOS or bootc experience for custom embedded distributions. Experience with NVIDIA Jetson platforms (Thor, Orin, Xavier, Nano or equivalent) and JetPack/L4T ecosystem. Power, thermal, or performance optimization on resource-constrained SoCs. Familiar with CI/CD, Git, and automated build/deployment processes. Know how to use debugging tools like JTAG, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers. Experience with the design, implementation and documentation

jobs.title: Senior Power Electronics Engineer
jobs.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role Power electronics are the bottleneck on every next-generation UAS airframe we build: motor controllers, gate drivers, and DC-DC stages are what define flight time, payload, thermal envelope, and field reliability. We're looking for a senior IC to own the analog power chain end-to-end across our UXV platforms: from MOSFET commutation simulation through PCB layout to lab validation. You will be the technical reference on power electronics inside our Lausanne engineering hub, unblocking propulsion, airframe, and embedded teams in parallel as we scale from prototype cadence to multi-platform deployment. This is a builder role, not a research seat. You ship hardware. Responsibilities Power Stage Architecture: Lead motor-controller and DC-DC topology across fixed-wing, multicopter, and hybrid UXV platforms. Translate mission constraints into power-chain specification. MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs. Multi-fidelity Simulation: Deploy the full stack: analytical loss budgeting, transient SPICE (LTspice), system-level modelling in PLECS or Simulink. BLDC Drive Stages: Design three-phase inverters with integrated current sensing, protection, Trapezoidal and FOC-aware hardware interfaces. High-Power-Density PCBA: Lead schematic and layout in Altium or KiCad with thermal, parasitics, and EMC engineered in from the first revision. EMI / EMC Engineering: Drive pre-compliance, filter design, and root-cause debug under flight-representative loads. Prototype-to-Production: Take motor-controller PCBAs through revision discipline, DFM, and qualification - closing the loop on field returns. Lab Validation: Execute bench characterization (power analysers, oscilloscopes, thermal imaging, double-pulse testing) and reconcile against simulation. Firmware & Controls Interface: Partner with embedded and propulsion on FOC tuning, current-sense calibration, and the hardware/firmware compensation boundary. Design Authority & Mentorship: Set the bar via design-decision records and reference designs. Mentor 1–2 junior engineers. Candidate Requirements MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or equivalent. 5+ years of hands-on R&D experience on motor drives, BLDC/PMSM controllers, or high-power-density power electronics. Deep working mastery of MOSFET commutation design : gate-driver selection, dead-time tuning, switching transitions, loss budgets. Proven ownership of at least one motor-controller PCBA shipped from prototype through production (or pre-production qualification) : ideally on drone, robotics, eVTOL, or automotive platforms. Fluency in simulation (LTspice, PLECS, or Simulink) and PCB design (Altium). Strong, hard-earned intuition for EMI / EMC design and debug. Lab-bench discipline: you've personally debugged what simulation missed. Comfort with scale-up iteration speed and end-to-end ownership. English fluent (working language); French is a nice-to-have, not a requirement. Bonus points for: GaN / SiC experience, safety-critical design exposure , applied control theory implemented in hardware, exposure to defense, aerospace, or UAS programmes. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager - EMEA
jobs.description: Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the Role: Hi there! We're hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Product Marketing team. We're a group that cares about getting the story right, not just getting it out the door. We work closely with product, sales, and demand gen, and we hold ourselves to a high bar because our work directly shapes how the market understands what we build. This role gives you real ownership. You'll shape positioning and messaging for a meaningful piece of our product portfolio, build the competitive intelligence that keeps our field teams sharp, and work directly with sales leaders who depend on your materials to close deals. It's a role with visible impact, not one where your work disappears into a shared drive. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll drive go-to-market strategy for your area, from positioning through launch through enablement, while partnering with product and sales to make sure the message actually lands. This role matters because clear, credible product marketing is what turns a strong platform into a business result. Camunda operates in a technical, complex space, and getting that translation right is not optional. What You Will Do Own positioning and messaging for your product area, translating technical capability into a clear value proposition for both technical and business buyers. Build and maintain a competitive intelligence program that sales actually uses, not just battlecards that sit in a folder. Lead go-to-market execution for launches in your area, coordinating across product, sales, and demand gen so the message is consistent everywhere it shows up. Arm the field with content that works in real conversations: pitch decks, demos, solution briefs, and objection handling. Use market and customer research to inform product and positioning decisions, not just to validate ones already made. Mentor and support other marketers on your team, sharing what you've learned without being asked. What You Will Bring to the Role Significant experience in B2B product marketing, ideally in enterprise software, with a track record of owning positioning and messaging end to end, not just contributing pieces of it. A real competitive intelligence practice under your belt. You've built and maintained a program that sales relied on, not just responded to research requests as they came in. Comfort marketing technical products to technical buyers. You can go deep enough into a technical concept to be credible with a developer, and simplify it enough to be clear to an executive. Field enablement experience at scale. You've built programs that changed how a sales team talked about a product, and you know how to tell if it worked. Strong cross-functional instincts. Durch maßgeschneiderte Lösungen schaffen wir einen echten Mehrwert für unsere Rahmenvertragspartner in der öffentlichen Verwaltung. Aktuell suchen wir für einen unserer Kunden einen Senior IT Architect (m/w/d). Projektstandort: Bonn Zeitraum: 2. November 2026 bis 31. Dezember 2026 Arbeitsmix: 30 Tage Remote/ 5 Tage vor Ort Wichtig: Remote-Arbeit nur in Deutschland möglich Wichtig: Projektsprache in deutsch Wichtig: Bereitschaft zur SÜ2 nach § 9 SÜG Geheim/Sabotageschutz Verlängerung für 2027 möglich DEINE MISSION Bei unserem Kunden wird im Rahmen der Weiterentwicklung einer Cloud an Konzeption und dem Aufbau eines zentralen Repositories für Software gearbeitet. In der Anlage erfolgt ein Aufbau zunächst für den OpenSouce Cloud Stack, es sollen aber Konzepte und Proof of Conzepts für any Software on any Platform entwickelt werden. Für diese Software Produkte müssen Funktions- und Lasttests in der Cloud konzipiert und erprobt werden. Die Aufgaben im Detail: Analyse funktionaler und nicht-funktionaler Anforderungen. Identifikation von technischen Rahmenbedingungen und Schnittstellen. Entwurf von Systemkomponenten, Schnittstellen und Datenflüssen. Analyse interner und externer Abhängigkeiten zwischen Modulen, Services und Drittsystemen. Bewertung der Auswirkungen von Abhängigkeiten auf Wartbarkeit, Erweiterbarkeit und Release-Zyklen. Definition von Integrationsstrategien z. B. API-Gateways, Adapter, Service Mesh. Recherche und Bewertung alternativer Technologien, Frameworks oder Produkte. Erstellung von Entscheidungsgrundlagen z. B. Pro/Contra-Tabellen, Proof-of-Concepts. Risikoanalyse bei Migration oder Einführung neuer Lösungen. Erstellung eines Plans zur Containerisierung bestehender oder neuer Komponenten. Bewertung von Eignung zur Containerisierung Statefulness, Abhängigkeiten, Ressourcenverbrauch. Definition von Vorgaben für Containerisierung. Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentation. Architektur-Reviews, DevOps-Unterstützung Sicherstellung von Performance, Skalierbarkeit, Verfügbarkeit und Sicherheit. Integration von Authentifizierung, Autorisierung und Verschlüsselung. Umsetzung von Security-by-Design und Privacy-by-Design. Technische Abstimmung mit Dev-Teams, Operations, Product Ownern und externen Partnern. Präsentation und Verteidigung von Architekturentscheidungen vor Management oder Kunden. jobs.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Personal- und Organisationsentwicklung Vertrieb
jobs.description: Mut ist unser Antrieb, Zusammenhalt ist unsere Stärke. Seit über 160 Jahren begleiten wir Menschen zuverlässig durchs Leben – mit einem innovativen Portfolio an Versicherungs- und Vorsorgeprodukten. Als Versicherungsverein auf Gegenseitigkeit gestalten wir gemeinsam mit mehr als 600 Mitarbeitenden die Zukunft der Versicherung neu und legen dabei besonderen Wert auf soziale und ökologische Verantwortung. Unsere Mitarbeitenden sind das Herzstück unseres Erfolgs. Wir leben eine offene, vertrauensvolle Unternehmenskultur und heißen Menschen jeden Alters, jeder Herkunft und Lebensweise willkommen, die gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft gestalten wollen. Kurz zusammengefasst – das erwartet dich Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) unterstützt du unser Team bei der stetigen persönlichen und fachlichen Weiterentwicklung unserer Vertriebspartnerinnen und Vertriebspartner innerhalb unserer Vertriebsorganisationen sowie bei der Optimierung unserer Vertriebsprozesse. Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben  Gemeinsam mit dem Team organisierst du Schulungen und unterstützt bei allen anfallenden Aufgaben rund um unsere Akademie, von der Planung bis zur Nachbereitung. Die Betreuung unserer Webinare liegt in deinen Händen: Du koordinierst Termine und Inhalte mit Referierenden, legst Veranstaltungen im Lernmanagementsystem an, bewirbst diese und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Ablauf. Für neue Mitarbeitende planst und koordinierst du gemeinsam mit den Trainerinnen die passenden Trainingsangebote, behältst Neueintritte im Blick und stimmst dich mit den relevanten Ansprechpartnern ab. Im Rahmen der Akademie-Administration kümmerst du dich um Anmeldungen, Dokumentationen sowie die Pflege von Ein- und Austritten und sorgst für aktuelle und verlässliche Daten. In engem Austausch mit den Trainerinnen begleitest du die Entwicklung unserer Trainees, dokumentierst Fortschritte und unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung von Lern- und Qualifizierungsmaßnahmen. Darüber hinaus wirkst du an der Optimierung digitaler Trainingsformate in Retorio mit, betreust Lernkohorten und unterstützt bei organisatorischen Themen wie Kick-off-Terminen, Projekten und der Rechnungsbearbeitung.   Das bringst du mit Du studierst Betriebswirtschaftslehre, (Wirtschafts-)Pädagogik, (Wirtschafts-)Psychologie, Personalmanagement oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang und kannst uns für mindestens zwei Semester mit 18 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen. Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Personalentwicklung, Aus- und Weiterbildung, Organisationsentwicklung, Vertriebsmanagement oder Prozessoptimierung gesammelt. Der Umgang mit Microsoft Office und digitalen Anwendungen fällt dir leicht. In neue Tools und Systeme arbeitest du dich schnell und gerne ein. Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und zuverlässig, behältst Termine im Blick und setzt auch bei mehreren Themen die richtigen Prioritäten. Kommunikation zählt zu deinen Stärken: Du arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnern zusammen, stimmst dich proaktiv ab und bist ein verlässlicher Teamplayer. Mit deiner positiven Art, deiner Eigeninitiative und deiner Begeisterung für die Weiterentwicklung von Trainings und Prozessen bringst du frische Ideen ins Team ein. Neugierig geworden? jobs.title: Senior Professional Services Engineer - OX App Suite (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Our mission: Are you an engineer with real technical depth AND do you want to own the relationship with one of our major hosting customer? Working through real production problems, translating operational needs into product improvements, and filling a role that matters to both sides? This combination is rare. At Open-Xchange (OX), we develop open-source communication and collaboration software used by public sector organizations, telcos, and hosting providers to keep data secure and under their control. Our products cover email, collaboration, DNS security, and related services, and are used by millions of people worldwide. Discover what OX offers you: We work in a non-hierarchical organization that empowers everyone to take responsibility, stay focused, and contribute directly to the company’s success and customer value. We value expertise and continuous professional development. Our professionals work closely with experienced colleagues, take ownership of their work, and continuously expand their skills. Openness and diversity are core to OX. Different perspectives, backgrounds, and ways of thinking strengthen our collaboration and help us see the bigger picture. Your team: You'll work in a dedicated cell built around one of our largest hosting customers - a provider running multiple brands on OX App Suite 8. Your closest collaborators are the Account Manager and Development Engineers, with Support looped in as needed. It's a largely independent seat, but you're one of several engineers across the company running the same model for other large accounts . Your new job: Be present in the customer relationship - regular calls, occasional on-site visits, and persistent continuity that the customer's technical teams know you by name and trust your word. Build reference labs and generate reference configurations from them. Participate in OX-internal development of those frameworks. Analyze and resolve technical issues across the OX App Suite 8 stack. As L1/L2 is sitting with our customer your role is escalation-facing (L2/L3) taking ownership from escalation through to resolution and keeping the customer informed throughout. Translate customer feature requests and operational requirements into clear input for internal product and development teams, and feedback internal constraints to the customer in terms they can act on. Support the customer through upgrades, configuration changes, and new feature rollouts. Document solutions, workarounds, and deployment specifics - both for the customer and internally - and leave things better documented than you found them. Formal on-call is not part of this role. jobs.description: **CHILLQUANTA **Bochum, Germany (Ruhr University Bochum) | On-site / Hybrid | Co-Founder / Equity | Deep Tech / Quantum & Semiconductor Metrology **About ChillQuanta **ChillQuanta is developing an electro-optic spectrometer for inspecting and characterizing photonic qubits (semiconductor quantum-dot single- and entangled-photon sources), aiming to replace or combine today's separate methods (capacitance-voltage, photoluminescence, resonance fluorescence spectroscopy) with one new sub-100-femtosecond-resolution, non-destructive electro-optic technique — with a patent filing already in progress. Target market: quantum and semiconductor chip makers. **The opportunity **Founded by Amar Alok (CEO, PhD in Experimental Physics from RUB, 4+ years in ultrafast optics and pump-probe spectroscopy) alongside a Chemistry postdoc, ChillQuanta has a lab prototype (TRL 3-4) benchmarked against single-atom data, an Invention Disclosure accepted by RUB (April 2026) with a manuscript in preparation for Physical Review Letters, and over €12k raised so far. The next step is turning the lab prototype into an automated instrument and deciding between licensing and starting a company — which is where a business co-founder comes in. ChillQuanta is separately also open to an AI/ML co-founder to help build wafer-scale AI prediction capability. Tasks What you will own Company build-up & strategy - Help decide and execute the path from lab prototype to company: licensing vs. start-up, incorporation, and go-to-market strategy for the quantum/semiconductor metrology market. - Own fundraising strategy and investor relations as ChillQuanta moves beyond its initial ~€12k raised. Commercialization - Turn the lab prototype (TRL 3-4) into an automated, sellable instrument in partnership with the technical team. - Build relationships with semiconductor and quantum chip makers as early customers and design partners. Business operations - Establish the commercial and operational foundation (pricing, business model, partnerships) the founding science team doesn't yet have. Requirements **What you bring ** **Core experience **- Business development or MBA-level commercial experience, ideally with deep-tech, scientific instrumentation, or semiconductor/quantum industry exposure. - Comfort making a licensing-vs-startup call and building a go-to-market plan from a lab-stage prototype. **Especially valuable **- Existing network in quantum technology, semiconductor metrology, or scientific instrumentation. - Fundraising experience for deep-tech ventures (grants and/or investors). - ChillQuanta is separately seeking an AI/ML co-founder to build wafer-scale AI prediction — relevant ML/software experience is valuable for that parallel track. Benefits Why join ChillQuanta - A validated lab prototype (TRL 3-4) benchmarked against single-atom data, with an Invention Disclosure already accepted by RUB and a manuscript heading to Physical Review Letters. - A genuinely novel technique (patent filing in progress) addressing a real gap in photonic-qubit inspection for the fast-growing quantum and semiconductor chip markets. - Ground-floor business co-founder equity alongside a strong physics/chemistry founding team. ChillQuanta welcomes co-founder candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, sexual identity, or any other characteristic. Mit der Klub-App ermöglichen wir es jungen Menschen, ihre eigene Stadt und ihre Vorlieben zu entdecken, und die Welt um sich herum mitzugestalten. Alle jungen Menschen haben das Recht auf ein freies und schöpferisches Leben, daran glauben wir fest. Nebenbei möchten wir die Schul- und Berufsbildung radikal transformieren. Mit der Klub-App erhalten Jugendliche ab 12 Jahren einen chancengerechten Zugang zu kostenfreien Freizeit- und Berufsorientierungsangeboten. Außerschulische Standorte – z. B. Jugendclubs, Makerspaces, Orte der kulturellen Bildung – können auf unserer App ihre Angebote direkt und digital an Jugendliche kommunizieren. Das Ganze bauen wir als Game auf: Entdecke deine Stadt, dich selbst, und bekomme dafür Rewards! Gleichzeitig hast du einen zweiten Auftrag, der genauso wichtig ist: Du führst so viele Projekte wie möglich über unsere Standardprozesse, damit Klub als Plattform skalierbar bleibt und nicht in Sonderlösungen erstickt. Diese Doppelrolle – nach außen verbindlich, nach innen konsequent – ist der Kern des Jobs. Wir freuen uns auf Mitunternehmer*innen, um gemeinsam mit dem jungen Team und Geschäftsführer Sebastian die Geschicke von Klub44 zu leiten. Projektsteuerung Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung unserer laufenden Kooperationsprojekte – von Kick-off bis Abschluss. Planung von Meilensteinen, Verantwortlichkeiten und Terminen; Nachhalten, wenn es hakt. Frühzeitiges Erkennen von Risiken und aktives Gegensteuern, statt Überraschungen am Projektende. Sicherstellen, dass zugesagte Ziele (z. B. teilnehmende Standorte, aktive Jugendliche, Angebots-Uploads) tatsächlich erreicht werden. Aufbau langfristiger Beziehungen: Bestehende Kooperationen erfolgreich umsetzen, verlängern und ausbauen. Erwartungsmanagement mit Verwaltungen, Schulleitungen und Förderpartnern: klar sagen, was geht, und was nicht. Übersetzungsarbeit zwischen kommunaler Logik und Startup-Tempo – in beide Richtungen. Skalierbarkeit & Standardprozesse Onboarding von Kommunen, Schulen und Jugendeinrichtungen entlang unserer Standardprozesse – wiederholbar statt jedes Mal neu. Weiterentwicklung dieser Prozesse: Playbooks, Templates, Checklisten, Automatisierungen. Erkennen, wann eine Partneranfrage ein Sonderfall ist – und wann sie in ein neues Standardangebot gehört. Bewusstes Nein zu Individuallösungen, die uns langfristig teuer werden. Zahlen, Reporting & Wirkung Nachhalten der Projekt-KPIs und transparentes internes Reporting zum Projektstatus. Aufbereitung von Projektständen und Wirkungsdaten für Zuwendungsgeber und Stiftungen – die Verantwortung für Verwendungsnachweise und Reportings liegt bei der Geschäftsführung, du lieferst die Grundlage. Ableiten konkreter Maßnahmen aus den Zahlen, nicht nur Dokumentation. Zusammenarbeit im Team Enge Abstimmung mit Geschäftsführung, Marketing & Community und Produktentwicklung. Rückkopplung von Partner-Feedback ins Produkt: Was brauchen Kommunen und Standorte wirklich? Steuerung externer Partner und Dienstleister im Projektkontext. Qualifikation Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und bringst Projekte nachweislich zum Abschluss – idealerweise mit Partnern aus Verwaltung, Bildung, Stiftungen oder NGOs. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com !    We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces.    If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife The team   Unsecured Personal Loans is one of Zopa’s largest and most established products, sitting at the heart of the bank’s growth ambitions. As a Product Manager in UPL Growth, you will own a meaningful part of how we originate loans: the decisioning, data and product journeys that determine who we can lend to, how confidently we can make an offer, and how simply customers can access one.   This is far more than keeping a mature product moving. You will have the space to identify the biggest opportunities to improve conversion, eligibility and growth, then take them from a commercial hypothesis through discovery and delivery into measurable results. That might mean rethinking how we use third-party data, improving a partner journey, or changing the rules and logic behind our lending decisions.   You will work in a small, ambitious product team alongside three flexible backend engineering teams, with close partnership from Credit Risk, Data Science and First Line Risk. The work is complex, fast-moving and consequential: the decisions you shape will directly influence customer outcomes and the scale of Zopa’s lending business. The work sits closer to commercial and analytical reasoning than to customer discovery — you will spend as much time interrogating data, sizing opportunities and shaping decisioning logic as you will running user research. If that sounds like the kind of PM work you are drawn to, this role is built for you.  A day in the life Own a defined area of the UPL growth roadmap, from opportunity sizing through to launch, measurement and iteration.   Turn commercial and customer signals into a clear product strategy, choosing where to focus and what not to pursue.   Shape the origination and decisioning experience, including the rules, journeys and data that sit behind a customer receiving a loan offer.   Lead cross-functional discovery with Engineering, Credit Risk and Data Science to find the most valuable, feasible route to growth.   Develop propositions that give customers greater clarity and confidence before they invest time in a full application.   Make the call on scope and sequencing, balancing customer value, risk, commercial return and engineering effort.   Use data to uncover friction, validate hypotheses and quantify the impact of your work.   Bring new growth ideas into the roadmap, from smarter use of existing data to new external data sources and partner opportunities.   Translate complex lending and technical problems into decisions that senior stakeholders can align behind.   Build, launch and continually improve products that help Zopa move closer to becoming the UK’s leading unsecured lender.   About you You are analytically strong and comfortable using data to find non-obvious product insight.   You have made product decisions that delivered measurable commercial outcomes.   You can partner

You'll join Infrastructure, the team that owns the platform every other Primer engineer builds and ships on. CI/CD, deployment, internal tooling, ephemeral environments: if it's how code gets from a laptop to production safely, it's ours. We operate the way the rest of Primer does. Remote-first, async, high autonomy, low bureaucracy. You build it, you own it, and that includes running it in production. You'll report to the Engineering Manager for Infrastructure & Data and work alongside a small group of senior infrastructure engineers. What makes this interesting right now is the human-AI development loop. Coding agents are changing how software gets built, and we want someone to own how that actually works at Primer rather than bolting it on. That part of the role is yours to define. What will you be doing? Own Primer's internal developer platform end to end: the CI/CD pipelines, deployment workflows (canary, blue/green), self-service tooling and ephemeral environments that every engineer here depends on to ship. Build the human-AI development loop. This is the most open part of the role: the tooling and automation that let engineers work effectively alongside coding agents, and the patterns that make agent-driven workflows fast and safe at Primer. Treat developer productivity as a measurable system. Instrument it, find where delivery actually slows down, and ship the changes that fix it instead of guessing. Take real operational ownership. Set the technical direction for how Primer's engineers build and ship, and bring less experienced engineers along with you as you do it. Improve how engineers write code, not just how they ship it.
