jobs.title: Post-Doctorant·e en Intelligence artificielle informée par la physique pour la modélisation hydrogéologique - CDD 13 mois - IMT Mines Alès
jobs.description: Venez rejoindre l'IMT Mines Alès, grande école de prestige qui se classe parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs sur le plan national et mondial et implantée à Alès, ville à taille humaine, capitale des Cévennes où la qualité de vie est fortement appréciée par ses habitants. Créée en 1843, IMT Mines Alès compte à ce jour 1400 élèves (dont 250 étrangers) et 380 personnels. L’école dispose de 3 centres de recherche et d’enseignement de haut niveau scientifique et technologique, qui œuvrent dans les domaines des matériaux et du génie civil (C2MA), de l’environnement et des risques (CREER), de l’intelligence artificielle et du génie industriel et numérique (CERIS). Elle dispose de 12 plateformes technologiques et compte 1600 entreprises partenaires. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.imt-mines-ales.fr Vous êtes rattaché(e) au Centre de Recherche et d’Enseignement en Environnement et Risques (CREER) de l'IMT Mines Alès et dans l'unité de recherche : HSM. Ce travail s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet PREV’IA qui s’intéresse à la connaissance et à la prévision des ressources en eaux de la nappe plioquaternaire de la plaine de Roussillon, et de la source du Lez qui alimente Montpellier en eau potable. Votre travail s’inscrira dans la continuité d’une thèse en cours au sein de l’UMR HSM (équipe HYTAKE), portant sur la durabilité de la ressource en eau karstique (aquifère du Lez) alimentant une métropole méditerranéenne (Montpellier) en contexte de changement climatique.   Votre mission : Utiliser les concepts émergeants dans les approches de « Physics Informed Machine Learning » (PIML) pour évaluer les intérêts d’une synergie en modélisation hydrogéologique : (1) à base conceptuelle d’une part et (2) à base de réseaux de neurones informés, ou complémentés, par la physique. L’approche PIML (Physics Informed Machine Learning) est développée, avec deux courants : (i) les Physics Informed Architecture (PIA) : intégration de connaissances physiques dans l’architecture du modèle (couches cachées) ; et (ii) les Physics Informed Loss Function (PILF) : combinaison de modélisations physiques (équations différentielles) et boîte noire, fusionnées dans la fonction de coût (terme de régularisation). Les deux méthodes pourront être explorées. Les modèles proposés pourront être utilisés pour déterminer l’évolution de certaines grandeurs hydrologiques en réponse au changement climatique. Vous trouvez plus d’information sur le descriptif du poste ci-dessous : https://partage.imt.fr/index.php/s/ANqeAPRfSdBfnof Niveau de formation et/ou expérience minimums requis : Doctorat dans un des domaines liés à l’hydrogéologie, l’hydrologie, ou la modélisation de l’environnement Compétences, connaissances et expériences requises : Expérience en machine Learning pour la modélisation des phénomènes naturels complexes Valorisation des compétences dans le cadre de projet(s) pluridisciplinaire(s) Réelles aptitudes et une expérience en organisation et travail en équipe : organisation de réunions, planification des actions, contribution à la rédaction de documents administratifs Bonne pratique de l’anglais scientifique Informations complémentaires : CDD de 13 mois de droit public - Emploi ouvert aux fonctionnaires & contractuels Informations à usage interne à destination des agents sur Cadre de gestion de l'IMT : Catégorie métier de référence du poste : II - P Ce poste est ouvert à toutes et tous. L’IMT Mines Alès s’engage à mettre en place les aménagements nécessaires pour les personnes en situation de handicap, afin de garantir un environnement de travail inclusif et accessible.  Salaire : 35 542 € brut annuel. jobs.description: Notre mission ⚖️ Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe. Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée. Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance. Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Chaos Engineering
jobs.description: <p>Datadog’s Chaos Engineering team builds systems that surface reliability weaknesses before they become outages. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will initially focus on zonal resilience, building automation that helps services safely evacuate and recover from zonal failures, while also contributing to fault injection, incident replay, gameday orchestration, and reliability tooling. You will work across engineering teams to design systems that safely exercise production failure modes and turn findings into verified remediation. You will also help advance the use of AI and automation to identify, test, and close resilience gaps as Datadog’s software and infrastructure evolve.</p> <p>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build zonal-resilience automation that coordinates safe workload evacuations, switchovers, and recovery in partnership with the teams that own affected services.</li> <li>Design and build fault-injection systems for production environments, including infrastructure- and application-level testing, incident replay, and controlled resilience experiments.</li> <li>Develop safeguards such as blast-radius controls, kill switches, validation mechanisms, and rollback paths that keep production experiments contained and reversible.</li> <li>Build agents and automation that help propose failure scenarios, triage experiment results, and connect reliability findings to tracked remediation and verification.</li> <li>Lead gamedays from hypothesis and scenario design through execution, documented findings, remediation tracking, and validation of completed fixes.</li> <li>Design and implement reliable distributed systems, including gRPC services, Kubernetes controllers, and shared platform components, while contributing to technical design and mentoring other engineers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have strong distributed systems fundamentals and can reason about consistency, failure modes, backpressure, idempotency, quorum, retries, and failure recovery.</li> <li>You understand Kubernetes workload lifecycles, including how pods, controllers, scheduling, draining, and eviction interact with resilient system design.</li> <li>You have experience designing, building, or operating production systems where safety, availability, and controlled failure handling are important.</li> <li>You communicate complex technical decisions clearly through design documents, runbooks, postmortems, and cross-functional technical discussions.</li> <li>You are comfortable collaborating across engineering teams to understand unfamiliar systems, identify failure modes, and drive resilience improvements.</li> <li>Experience with reliability engineering, chaos engineering, zonal failover, AI-assisted operational workflows, traffic interception, or large-scale observability systems is beneficial but not required.</li> </ul> <p>Datadog values people from all walks of life. We know not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That’s okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.</p> <p><strong>Benefits and Growth:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop deep expertise in distributed systems, production resilience, Kubernetes, and large-scale infrastructure.</li> <li>Work on reliability systems that operate across Datadog’s production environment and influence how engineering teams design for failure.</

jobs.title: Partner Marketing Senior Manager
jobs.description: Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. GET TO KNOW US At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.  Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! THE OPPORTUNITY Partner Marketing exists to fuel the growth and success of Wellhub's global partner network of gyms, studios and wellness businesses. The Senior Manager, Partner Marketing (France & Benelux) leads Partner Marketing strategy and execution for these markets, as part of Wellhub's regional EU Partner Marketing team. This person will act as the regional Point of Contact (POC) for Partner Marketing in France and Benelux, owning the local Business-to- Partner value proposition, brand positioning, network growth and engagement and, fitness industry events, working closely with Partnerships, local and cross-functional Marketing, Wellbeing Engagement, Product Development and Revenue teams to align strategy and execution. Reporting to the Partner Marketing Director, EU, this role combines strategic ownership of the region with hands-on execution. This role directly impacts the growth and satisfaction of Wellhub's partner network in France and Benelux, contributing to the team's broader goals around partner network growth, partner engagement, and partner satisfaction (PSAT).   YOUR IMPACT Market-Specific Value Proposition: Develop and implement the local Business to Partner value proposition across all partner-facing materials and touchpoints for France and Benelux. Brand Awareness & Positioning: Build Wellhub's presence and credibility within the regional fitness industry through relationships with industry associations/alliances, sponsorships, events, media/publications, and key opinion leaders (KOLs). Strategic Partner Growth (B2P2C): Lead go-to-market strategy for partner launches, relaunches, and dedicated campaigns and promotions to end users and clients, driving growth with existing partners. Strategic Partner Engagement: Build partner trust through structured engagement initiatives, including fitness industry events, partner conferences and summits. Network Growth Support: Support the Demand Generation team's strategy with local market insights and develop sales enablement materials to drive growth across the partner network. Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Partnerships,  User Growth, Corporate communication, Content, Revenue teams local and global level to align initiatives with company-wide strategy. Budget Ownership: Manage the regional Partner Marketing budget for France and Benelux, allocating resources across campaigns, events and other marketing initiatives to drive results and maximize ROI. Data-Driven Marketing: Use performance data and partner insights to inform, prioritize and continuously optimize Partner Marketing initiatives in the region. AI-Driven Productivity: Autonomously identify and apply AI tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude) to raise the team's level of automation — streamlining repetitive tasks, accelerating content, reporting and campaign production, and embedding AI-assisted workflows into day-to-day ways of working. Continuously build personal AI fluency and share practices that help the broader team work smarter. Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work

jobs.title: SMB Success Junior Account Executive
jobs.description: Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. GET TO KNOW US At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. We operate in 18 countries worldwide and our platform supports more than 40,000 clients, connecting their employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription.  Headquartered in NYC with team members across Europe, North America, and South America (2,000+ Wellhubbers and counting!), we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company. As we continue to grow, we're extending our presence across Europe, with France among our next key markets! We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.  Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!   THE OPPORTUNITY We are hiring a Client Success Account Executive II to join our SMB team in Paris ! This is a hybrid role, requiring a minimum of two days per week in our Paris office. Wellhub is officially expanding into France, and you will join a high-impact team at the forefront of this new venture! As one of the first SMB BDRs in the country, you will play a key role in building our presence from the ground up—generating pipeline, engaging HR leaders, and contributing to both the development of our local sales playbook and our go-to-market approach. This is a rare opportunity to take on real ownership from day one, introduce a global brand to a new market, and help shape our long-term success in France. YOUR IMPACT Reporting to the Country Lead your core mission will be to manage a wide portfolio of growing B2B businesses (typically up to 500 employees) and ensure their long-term satisfaction through the following pillars: High-Velocity Onboarding: Lead the digital launch and setup process for a high volume of new SMB clients, guiding HR leads and business owners through their first 90 days seamlessly. Engagement & Activation Drive: Create and execute scalable communication strategies (webinars, automated campaigns, and digital toolkits) to introduce Wellhub to our clients' workforces and rapidly increase user sign-ups. Portfolio Health & Optimization: Monitor account health data to proactively identify low-engagement accounts, intervening with creative solutions to boost activation and prevent early churn. Commercial Retention: Own the renewal cycle for your portfolio, handling high-volume contract renewals, minor contract updates, and identifying upselling opportunities. Cross-Functional Bridge: Collaborate closely with the SMB Sales team to ensure smooth client handovers WHO YOU ARE You have 1+ year of experience in sales, high-velocity sales, or client-facing roles. Experience in a startup or in a "new market" environment is a big plus. You communicate confidently in French (native level) and fluently in English. You are motivated by targets and bring energy to outbound activity.  You're proactive, curious, and comfortable working in a fast-moving, evolving environment. You thrive on building processes from scratch and take ownership of your work. You are familiar with CRM tools such as Salesforce (a plus). You enjoy working as part of a team and contributing to a positive, collaborative environment. You are passionate about wellness and genuinely excited to help the French workforce lead happier, healthier lives.   We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team.  WHAT WE OFFER YOU  With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Design Systems
jobs.description: Who We Are Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the DuckDuckGo subscription . We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai , which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place! Your Team and Role As a Senior Product Designer, Design Systems you'll be the first of its kind at DuckDuckGo. You'll take ownership of our design system at a pivotal moment, with a chance to define both a role and a roadmap from the ground up — helping build the process, not just step into one. You'll audit our existing system, lead projects that move it forward across platforms and products like Duck.ai and Search, as well as shape how we manage and scale it as we grow. Applying your hands-on design skills, you will autonomously lead highly impactful projects that scale across millions of users, and collaborate with team members at all levels to pioneer new solutions as we build out the privacy layer for the internet. From ideation to execution, you'll assess vague problems, propose high-impact solutions, and execute them against a set of success criteria. You'll have a voice in all product-related design decisions, whether large or small, and an opportunity to work on a team dedicated to our ethical, privacy by design approach. Read more about Design at DuckDuckGo on our blog: https://spreadprivacy.com/ethical-by-design/ About You 7+ years of experience in product or design systems roles, including 2+ years in senior-level design positions at significant global consumer brands Demonstrable track record of building and scaling complex and established systems Ability to lead the future of our design system, from audit, recommending solutions, and planning their rollout via quick wins or large-scale projects Ability to communicate recommendations and prioritization with clear documentation, success metrics, resources, and rationale which stakeholders, designers, and engineers can confidently act on A knack for balancing structure with scale by creating frameworks (tokens, libraries) that hold up across platforms and teams without sacrificing craft Deep knowledge of design tools, such as Figma, that are key to evolving and maintaining the design system Experience bridging design and engineering practices, including creating shared nomenclature and workflows that map across tools and platforms Accustomed to applying agentic and AI-driven solutions into design system management and maintenance workflows, to both accelerate and elevate how the system scales Enjoy pushing creative limits while solving challenging design problems and delivering on delight, craft and exceptional quality Ability to communicate visual and interaction recommendations with high-quality mockups, prototypes, and rationale Skills to manage ambiguity and wrangle vague problems, propose innovative solutions, and execute them with a focus on metrics Ability to take initiative in generating ideas and carrying them forward with urgency and discretion, while working openly and collaboratively Compensation $ 178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation. jobs.title: Senior Sales Operations Manager, EMEA
jobs.description: About the Role As EMEA Sales Operations Lead, you'll build and scale the operational engine powering our regional Sales organization. Reporting to the Global Head of Revenue Operations, you’ll partner closely with EMEA Sales leadership to drive strategic planning, operational excellence, and data-driven decision making across the EMEA revenue funnel — while coordinating with the global Revenue Operations team to ensure alignment on systems, processes, and reporting standards. You will own core Sales Ops initiatives for the region including territory planning, forecasting support, pipeline management,and process optimization. This role requires a strategic operator who can balance close partnership with EMEA leadership with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environment. What You'll Do Serve as a trusted right hand to the EMEA GM and an active member of the GTM EMEA leadership team, providing operational insight that shapes regional strategy and decision-making Partner with EMEA Sales leadership to drive regional GTM strategy, territory design & planning, account prioritization, and performance optimization Establish operational rigor around forecasting, pipeline management, KPI definition, reporting, and business reviews for the EMEA region Own and optimize sales processes and workflows (along with your cross regional counterparts), coordinating with the global GTM Systems team to ensure consistency and scalability  Serve as the EMEA voice into global sales compensation structures, incentive programs, and SPIFF strategies Drive adoption and standardization of Salesforce and core GTM tools within EMEA, in close partnership with the global GTM Systems team. Who You Are Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS Revenue Operations or Sales Operations Strong experience supporting Sales and BDR/SDR motions in a high-growth environment Experience owning or partnering closely with Deal Desk operations Deep expertise with Salesforce and core revenue systems Comfort operating in a matrixed environment, partnering with regional leadership while coordinating with a global operations function Nice to Have: Experience with modern GTM tooling including Salesforce, Gong, and data enrichment platforms Experience driving AI-enabled workflows and automation within Revenue Operations Working knowledge of sales compensation design and GTM planning methodologies French, German, or another European language proficiency is a plus What We Offer Competitive compensation package (Highly competitive base salary, equity package, and comprehensive benefits). Champion our Customers: We lead with empathy, solve what matters, and deliver clarity in a complex world to make our customers heroes in their organizations. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Paris
jobs.description: Who we are Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves. We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow. Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education. Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions! About this role At Yubo, Product Managers have real ownership. They work in strong partnership with Product Designers and Engineering, shaping strategy and decisions from problem definition all the way to delivery, with direct and visible impact on both the product and the business. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to form that partnership with a Product Designer: a duo jointly responsible for the end-to-end experiences you ship together. You'll take ownership of a strategic product area, identify the biggest opportunities, and turn them into clear product bets on a product used by millions of people. We're moving away from small, isolated feature launches toward bigger, end-to-end experiences tested at scale . You'll combine user understanding, data and strong product convictions to frame problems, shape solutions with Design and Engineering, and decide what to scale, iterate, or stop. You'll also work closely with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing and Trust & Safety on challenges ranging from recommendation and discovery to retention, safety, monetization and AI. jobs.description: Who are we? The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable. Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction : detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them. We sell to navies and coast guards , and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy. Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa , the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk. ⚡ What is at stake in the coming months Confirm the technology at sea with navies and operators. Deploy and sign our first paid pilots. Sign our first contracts. By joining us, you'll play a key role in turning that early traction into multi-year protection contracts, and in building the sales team that follows. 🎯 Your mission Own every deal from first meeting to signed contract, with navies, port authorities and operators of cables and offshore energy. Sell interdiction, not detection alone: make the threat and the gap between alarm and response concrete for each buyer, then turn pilots into multi-year protection contracts. Shape requirements before the tender: work with navies and operators months ahead of an RFP so that it asks for detection and action together. Open our priority export markets: the Baltic and the Nordics, the Black Sea, the Gulf and Southeast Asia. Work as a pair with Gauthier, our Co-CEO, on key accounts, and bring Aymeric and the engineers in when the technical conversation starts. Build the partner channel: primes and integrators, offshore and cable operators, and local partners in each country. Turn every deployment into a reference the next customer can check. Set up the sales machine, then hire and lead the first sellers. 📈 How you will be measured First 3 months: you own the pipeline, have a qualified deal plan for each priority region, and a first paid pilot or LOI is signed. 6 months: paid pilots are running and the first contracts are signed. 12 months: recurring contracts in at least two countries, and your first sales hires are made and ramped. 🤩 This job is your dream job if: You have closed defense or government deals and want to do it again, from zero, where every contract changes the trajectory You like being the second half of a founder pair: the CEO brings operational credibility, you bring the deal You'd rather be on a plane to Tallinn, Constanța or Abu Dhabi than in a forecast meeting You speak engineer well enough to sell sensors, AI and C2 You want to write the sales playbook yourself, then hire the team that runs it 🙅 This job is not for you if: You need a brand, a marketing team and SDRs to sell You have only sold short-cycle SaaS or SMB deals, never through formal procurement You want to manage a large team from day one rather than close deals yourself Sales cycles of 12 to 24 months and 40% travel put you off You are looking for the comfort of a large defense group What we offer A founding role in a seed-stage defense tech company backed by Hexa Fixed salary, variable on signed revenue, BSPCE Offices in Paris, real deployments at sea 🧭 Our recruitment process A first call to get to know each other. jobs.title: Network Developer
jobs.description: Senior Network Developer About Share Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months. Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served. The Role Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices. You'll own the network architecture end to end. That covers our BGP edge (transit, peering at KIXP and LINX, private interconnects with hyperscalers), the backbone, and the PoPs and data centers we're adding across the continent. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team. What you'll do Design the backbone and PoP architecture as standard, repeatable building blocks, from edge to data center, so we can add capacity and new markets without redesigning each time. Drive our move to Segment Routing and a clean IP architecture, including IPv4 reuse, IPv6, and how customer and internal address space coexist. Build on disaggregated white-box hardware (Edgecore with IP Infusion OcNOS today), and make the hardware and software calls that keep us fast and affordable. Turn operations into software. That means a source of truth (Nautobot), templated config (Jinja), and CI/CD with validation, staged rollouts and rollback for every change. Build the telemetry and observability that show what the network is really doing. Use AI where it actually helps: anomaly detection, automated triage, and auto-remediation with a human in the loop. Own availability. Limit how much any failure can affect, mitigate first and diagnose second, and turn post-mortems into fixes in the system. Work with our software team on the API and provisioning layer that exposes the network to customers, and with partner ISPs' engineers on the hand-off. Help hire and develop the engineers who'll run this with you. Our Ideal Candidate 8+ years building and operating large networks at a hyperscaler, CDN, internet exchange, carrier or ISP. Deep BGP at scale: route policy, communities, RPKI, traffic engineering, peering and transit. Strong data center and backbone design. You know Clos/EVPN-VXLAN fabrics and MPLS or Segment Routing, and when each makes sense. Hands-on with white-box or disaggregated networking, including choosing hardware and knowing where the silicon limits you. You treat the network as code. You write automation yourself (Python or similar), and you've built or run the pipelines, source of truth and telemetry that make that safe. You've owned availability for something that couldn't go down, and can walk us through a real incident: what broke, how you found it, and what you changed. AI-native in how you work. You've built with these tools, not just used them, and you have a view on where they help in operations and where they don't. You think like an owner. You bring ideas, not tickets, and you want to help build a team, not just a network. A clear, direct communicator who's comfortable with partners' engineers and with our founders. Nice to have Experience at an internet exchange, or running peering at scale. Open networking stacks like SONiC, OcNOS or FRR, or contributions to them

jobs.title: Network Operation Engineer
jobs.description: Network Operations Engineer 1. About the role Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure into a single layer and give ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a clean path to deliver connectivity into every home and business across Kenya and the continent. Behind that marketplace is a real network: a BGP edge peering with Tier 1 transit, hyperscalers, and local exchanges, an MPLS backbone, aggregation and access gear, and the systems that watch all of it. For the partners who run on us, the network is the product, and the NOC is where they feel it. A clean shift is a partner who never knew anything happened. That is the bar. We are early and the team is small, so we cannot afford a pair of hands that only knows how to escalate. We need a capable network engineer who can stand a shift, resolve real faults without waking anyone, and then keep building the network while East Africa sleeps: propagation and peering checks, health passes across the estate, config changes through to merge, tickets off the board, automation that takes the next repetitive job off everyone's plate. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling. The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. The point is not to replace your judgment. It is to collapse the time between an alert firing and you knowing where to look, so mean time to repair is measured in minutes. You sit inside that system. You use it, you push back on it when it is wrong, and what you catch that it misses is part of how it gets smarter. As we build automation out across the NOC, you are not just a consumer of the tooling. You help write it. 2. What you'll do Watch, and know what you're looking at. Sit on our monitoring stack (Zabbix and Grafana dashboards, flow telemetry, alerting) and actually read it. Learn what normal looks like so abnormal jumps out at you: a BGP session that dropped, a link that went down, latency climbing on a path, a capacity threshold breached, a partner suddenly pushing or pulling nothing. Troubleshoot and resolve. This is where you earn your seat. Confirm the alert is real, gather the facts, and localise the fault: one peer or many, us or upstream, a real outage or a monitoring blip. The assistive layer surfaces a likely diagnosis and a suggested fix, the config history is right there in Git, and the runbooks are live. Your job is to read all of it critically, decide what is actually true, and close out what you can on your own. Every ticket you resolve yourself is one our senior people did not get pulled out of deep work, or out of bed, to deal with. Keep the network healthy, not just alive. A quiet shift is not an idle one. Run the proactive passes: check that routes are propagating the way they should, that RPKI and filter chains are doing their job, that peering and transit sessions are clean across the edge, that no PoP is drifting toward a capacity wall. Catch the slow degradations that never trip an alert. The day team should inherit a network in a known good state. Build and automate. The repetitive parts of this job should not stay repetitive. Write the scripts that turn a manual check into a scheduled one. Push our config automation forward (Jinja driven generation, NAPALM or NETCONF/gNMI against the devices) so changes ship from data, not from memory. When the assistive layer keeps missing the same thing, that is a candidate for automation, and you are well placed to build it during the hours nobody else is online. Move the work forward. You are part of the network team

jobs.title: Systemadministrator Linux (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll? 🚀 Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit zum Einsatz. Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten. Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source . In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen. Deine Benefits Gestaltungsspielraum: Entscheide aktiv mit, wie sich die interne IT in den Bereichen Linux, Open Source, Cyber Security, Resilience und Automatisierung weiterentwickelt. Spannende Zukunftsprojekte: Arbeite unter anderem an Open Source Migrationen, dem Ausbau der IT Security und einem eigenen internen Linux basierten KI Server. Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Arbeite eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Freiheit bei technischen Lösungen. Flexibles Arbeiten: Nutze flexible Arbeitszeiten ohne feste Kernarbeitszeit und arbeite in der Regel einen Tag pro Woche im Homeoffice . Individuell kann nach Absprache auch mehr Remote Arbeit möglich sein. 30 Urlaubstage: Profitiere von 30 Tagen Urlaub und individuellen Lösungen, wenn du darüber hinaus einmal eine längere Auszeit benötigst. Bonus: Zusätzlich zu deinem Fixgehalt erhältst du einen vom Unternehmenserfolg abhängigen Jahresbonus, der in erfolgreichen Jahren bereits bei mehreren Tausend Euro lag. Mobilität: Nutze das bezuschusste Deutschlandticket, JobRad, Firmenparkplätze, kostenloses Laden deines E Autos sowie Poolfahrzeuge für dienstliche Termine. Sport & Gesundheit: Profitiere von Hansefit, einem Boulderfelsen und einer Tischtennisplatte direkt am Standort sowie zahlreichen von Kollegen organisierten Aktivitäten wie Klettern, Mountainbiken oder Kajaken. Team & Events: Freue dich auf Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, gemeinsame Grillnachmittage auf der Dachterrasse sowie mehrtägige Entwickler Camps, bei denen bewusst neue Technologien und Themen ausprobiert werden. Weiterentwicklung: Erhalte individuell abgestimmte Weiterbildungen und einen Mentor aus einem anderen Unternehmensbereich als persönlichen Sparringspartner. Gehalt: Jahresbruttogehalt ab 60.000 € mit Bereitschaft zur deutlichen Überzahlung abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung. Deine Aufgaben Als Systemadministrator Linux hältst du nicht nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen, sondern entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team die zukünftige IT-Landschaft des Unternehmens. Linux & Infrastruktur: Verantworte und optimiere die Linux Systemlandschaft sowie die zugehörige Netzwerk- und IT-Infrastruktur. Open Source: Entwickle bestehende Systeme konsequent weiter und begleite Migrationen von Standardsoftware zu geeigneten Open Source Alternativen. Virtualisierung & Automatisierung: Arbeite mit Technologien wie Proxmox, Docker und vSphere und automatisiere Prozesse beispielsweise mit Python und Ansible. Cyber Security: Entwickle Security und Resilience weiter und beschäftige dich mit technischen Anforderungen rund um NIS 2, DSGVO, CRA und TISAX. KI Infrastruktur: Betreue und erweitere den unternehmense

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician (m/f/d) part time | ideal alongside your studies
jobs.description: Would you like to maintain more than just another technical system and work with a technology that is truly unique worldwide? ⚡ Our client is a fast growing GreenTech startup developing one of the world’s first scalable road based power plants. The technology uses existing road infrastructure to generate renewable energy from passing traffic without requiring any additional land. As a Maintenance Technician in Hamburg , you will be responsible for the technical operation and maintenance of the road based power plant installed there. You will ensure reliable operation, carry out maintenance and repairs, and systematically investigate technical faults. You will not simply follow existing procedures. Since this is an entirely new technology, you will actively help shape how maintenance, service, and technical support processes are developed for the future . Your hands on experience from daily operations will directly contribute to the continued development of the service structure. Your Benefits • Unique technology: Work with the world’s first road based power plant in active operation and contribute to a GreenTech solution that currently exists nowhere else in this form. • Real opportunity to shape processes: Develop maintenance schedules, service processes, and maintenance structures together with the team instead of simply following existing procedures. • Flexible part time schedule: Work 20 to 30 hours per week with flexible working hours that can easily be combined with university studies or other commitments. • Independent work: Take responsibility for the technical operation of the plant in Hamburg and enjoy a high degree of autonomy when it comes to maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs. • Development opportunities: Grow together with the technology and take on additional responsibility for operations and service as your experience increases. • Attractive compensation: Receive competitive compensation based on your qualifications and practical experience. Your Responsibilities As a Maintenance Technician , you will help ensure the reliable technical operation of the road based power plant in Hamburg. • Maintenance and repairs: Inspect and maintain the system across mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical components. Your responsibilities will also include tasks such as monitoring and maintaining the hydraulic oil. • Troubleshooting: Analyse technical issues, resolve faults, and document both the solution and the underlying cause. • Service development: Create and continuously improve maintenance schedules, spare parts lists, and technical service documentation for the system. • Spare parts management: Keep track of spare parts stored on site and ensure they are managed in a structured and reliable way. Your Profile as a Maintenance Technician • You have a technical background in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, energy technology , or a comparable technical qualification. • You have practical experience in the mechanical maintenance and repair of technical systems or machinery. • You have a solid understanding of hydraulic systems and are able to independently understand technical relationships and identify potential issues. • You are available for 20 to 30 hours per week and are flexible enough to occasionally work early mornings, evenings, or weekends when suitable maintenance windows are available at the terminal. • You enjoy taking responsibility, work independently, and remain calm and solution oriented when dealing with technical problems. • You enjoy working directly on technical equipment and outdoors and feel comfortable in an active traffic and logistics environment. • The ability to confidently read technical drawings, hydraulic schematics, and electrical circuit diagrams is an advantage. Would you like to do more than simply maintain a globally unique GreenTech system and actively help shape how its future operation and service structure are developed? ⚡ Then send us your CV and learn more about the comp

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager
jobs.description: Hi, we're Dana and Erik, the founders of Circonomit. We build the decision platform industrial companies use to plan their production. Dana sees the customer side. She needs to know which use cases we can sell today, which we cannot, and what a demo is allowed to claim. Erik sees the engineering side. He needs requirements that are ready to be built, complete, and clear about what we deliberately leave out. The product sits between the two, and that is this role. We sell vertically, one use case at a time, while the product has to stay general enough to serve the next customer without being rebuilt. You decide what we build next, in which order, and what we decline. How you will be measured: how much of today's project work is standard product a year from now, and how quickly a recognised customer problem becomes a usable capability. We came out of RWTH research, raised €2.8M with Vorwerk Ventures, and have customers running on our models today. Small team, Cologne office. Requirements 5+ years in product management, or consulting with genuine product proximity. You have owned a product area end to end, not only a backlog. A technical and analytical foundation: engineering, data, operations research, quantitative controlling, or finance with real modelling. You recognise when a requirement creates technical debt or will not be reusable at the next customer. You will not write production code. Experience deciding under incomplete information, and explaining the trade-offs afterwards: what you chose, why, and what it cost. You are comfortable working directly with plant managers and controllers, and understand how they decide today. German at C1 level or above, and fluent English. Customer conversations happen in German. Existing work visa for Germany. You should enjoy being in front of customers in your first week, and deciding without a research team behind you. Priorities change as we learn from customers, and we make scope and trade-offs explicit together. Benefits Ownership. The roadmap, and where the line between product and customer project sits. Shaping the role. This is the founding product role. You define how product works here: discovery, prioritisation, and the standards between product and engineering. Exposure. You present your roadmap and the reasoning behind it to the board, and you sit in the core strategy conversations. Real-world impact. Customers plan their production on our models today. Direct collaboration. Small team, no org chart. We work directly together. Weekly feedback, both ways. Compensation. Competitive salary plus a VSOP package reflecting your contribution and development in the role. Hybrid work. Our HQ is in Cologne, and we meet there regularly. Your setup and everyday extras. Hardware of your choice · AI tooling budget · sports membership · Deutschland-Ticket. Process: An intro call, a second conversation with the team, a 60- to 90-minute live case on a real customer requirement, then in-person conversations with the team. jobs.title: Research Staff, Voice AI Foundations
jobs.description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. The Opportunity Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone. The Role As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems: Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio. Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech. Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”. Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio. Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment

jobs.title: FDE Data Engineer- Space (FedD141/FedD147)
jobs.description: EMPLOYER IS A CONTRACTOR FOR THE U.S. GOVERNMENT. THIS POSITION WILL REQUIRE U.S. CITIZENSHIP. Role Description This is a forward-deployed engineering role. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with mission heroes: the users, operators, and program engineers who run real workloads in real DoD environments. You'll help take UDS Data Capability from "deployable" to "running in production under classification." You will deploy, integrate, and operate our data stack in the mission hero's environment alongside senior engineers, then carry what you learn back into the product so the next engagement is easier. The scope of this work varies by engagement. Some programs require standing up a governed data platform to centralize sensor or operational data from known sources, where the problem is well-defined and the priority is building and shipping. Others involve consolidating data across hundreds of interconnected government systems of record with overlapping schemas, deeply interdependent data flows, and significant architectural complexity. You should be comfortable building independently against defined problems and growing into more ambiguous, complex engagements over time. Forward-deployed means aligned with the mission hero, not always on a plane. Most of the work is remote. You'll travel to sites when the engagement calls for it: initial standup, integration work, incident response, training and knowledge transfer. The rest of the time, you'll be on a video call or in a shared chat with that same mission hero. The role is defined by the relationship with the mission hero, not by where you sit. You are a data engineer who can build across the breadth of a data platform (storage, ingestion, streaming, governance, and access) and deliver working solutions in constrained, mission-critical environments. Responsibilities Deploy and configure UDS Data Capability in the mission hero's environment. Stand up the UDS Store (Iceberg, Rook/Ceph, pgvector, Postgres), wire up UDS Transit for air-gap data movement, configure UDS Govern policies (Pepr/Lula), and integrate UDS Connect (Strimzi/Kafka) where streaming or legacy connectors are required. Build and support integrations with existing mission systems. Connect UDS Data Capability to legacy databases, flat-file drops, SOAP/REST endpoints, message buses, existing object storage, and identity providers (Keycloak, mission-side SSO). Prior experience integrating with these types of systems is more relevant than experience building on them. Contribute to mapping complex data landscapes. Some engagements involve hundreds of interconnected systems of record with overlapping schemas and deeply interdependent data flows. You'll help trace how data moves across systems and identify dependencies alongside senior engineers and government stakeholders. Build pipelines that move data through classification boundaries, including ingestion, transformation, catalog registration, model/dataset packaging via Zarf, cross-domain transit, and eventual consistency across DDIL conditions. Implement data provenance, lineage, and governance practices. Track where data came from, how it transformed, and who can access it. Operate what you deploy. Day-2 ownership includes capacity, performance, backup/restore (Velero), observability (Vector/Loki), incident response, and upgrade paths. Hand off to the mission hero's ops team once it's stable. Generate accreditation artifacts, including STIG evidence, cATO documentation, FIPS validation notes, and policy mappings. You produce the evidence the mission hero's ISSM/ISSO needs to run this in IL4/IL5. Contribute field feedback back to product and engineering. File issues, write postmortems, and surface what's working and what's breaking in the mission environment. Support training and knowledge transfer. Contribute to runbooks, architecture docs, and working sessions that leave the mission hero's team self-sufficient. Preferred Locations: Colorado Springs, CO or Florida Spac

jobs.description: The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS. jobs.description: NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High Performance Computing and Visualization. Communication performance between the GPUs has a direct impact on the end-to-end application performance; and the stakes are even higher at huge scales! This is an outstanding opportunity for someone with HPC and performance background to advance the state of the art in this space. Are you ready for to contribute to the development of innovative technologies and help realize NVIDIA 's vision? Study the interaction of our libraries with all HW (GPU, CPU, Networking) and SW components in the stack Evaluate proof-of-concepts, conduct trade-off analysis when multiple solutions are available Triage and root-cause performance issues reported by our customers Collect a lot of performance data; build tools and infrastructure to visualize and analyze the information Collaborate with a very dynamic team across multiple time zones What we need to see: M.S. (or equivalent experience) or PHD in Computer Science, or related field with relevant performance engineering and HPC experience 3+ yrs of experience with parallel programming and at least one communication runtime (MPI, NCCL, UCX, NVSHMEM) Experience conducting performance benchmarking and triage on large scale HPC clusters Good understanding of computer system architecture, HW-SW interactions and operating systems principles (aka systems software fundamentals) Implement micro-benchmarks in C/C++, read and modify the code base when required Ability to debug performance issues across the entire HW/SW stack. Proficient in a scripting language, preferably Python Familiar with containers, cloud provisioning and scheduling tools (Kubernetes, SLURM, Ansible, Docker) Adaptability and passion to learn new areas and tools. Flexibility to work and communicate effectively across different teams and timezones Ways to stand out from the crowd: Practical experience with Infiniband/Ethernet networks in areas like RDMA, topologies, congestion control Experience debugging network issues in large scale deployments Familiarity with CUDA programming and/or GPUs Experience with Deep Learning Frameworks such PyTorch, TensorFlow NVIDIA is at the forefront of breakthroughs in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. Our teams are composed of driven, innovative professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology. We offer highly competitive salaries, an extensive benefits package, and a work environment that promotes diversity, inclusion, and flexibility. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a supportive and empowering workplace for all. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. For Poland: The base salary range is 221,250 PLN - 383,500 PLN for Level 3, and 292,500 PLN - 507,000 PLN for Level 4. Originally posted on Himalayas
